Modified 2026-10-24 for Noqui backwear research: extracted static native cuboids, remapped texture resource names, recentered and uniformly scaled geometry, and replaced display settings for ItemDisplay FIXED.
Original native Java per-face UVs and face rotations retained verbatim. Original _hand model selected; the generated inventory icon model is not used. PNG bytes copied verbatim.
Original mod instrument prop adapted as rigid backwear. Playback functionality and sound assets are not included.

Repository GPL-3.0 applies to models and textures; explicit exclusions cover sounds and melodies only. No sounds or melodies staged. Retain GPL license, notices, original model/texture sources, and this modification script when distributing these adaptations.
Original sources remain under upstream/ and are identified by SHA256 in candidates.json. Changes are reproducible with normalize_assets.py.
